methodology: On-disk temporary WAL catalog, 32 MiB cache, about 12.35 tracks per album, numeric filenames/folders, metadata absent from paths, 256 padding bytes per track. Warm-up plus three samples. Measures SQL and JS materialization, not IPC/rendering or cold disk. Only Tracks uses tag metadata; Albums and Covers retain path-only search. Dates remain the selected sort order; no persistent text index or relevance ranking.
